instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Unit U20 is still not applied: the file is unchanged from before the run, so this fix must make the whole U20 change from its brief (briefs/U20, sites S1-S10) and pass `yarn eslint --max-warnings 0 packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx`. The previous fix round's last attempt (Sonnet) applied cleanly within its sites and failed ONLY on these 3 prettier/prettier warnings, verbatim:
 2916:41 warning Replace `⏎······(page)·=>·page.id·!==·pageId,⏎····` with `(page)·=>·page.id·!==·pageId` prettier/prettier
 5214:33 warning Replace `appState·as·Partial<AppState>·|·null·|·undefined)` with `⏎········appState·as·Partial<AppState>·|·null·|·undefined` prettier/prettier
 5215:7 warning Replace `··` with `)` prettier/prettier
So: (a) the .filter callback near the deletePage code must stay on ONE line: `.filter((page) => page.id !== pageId)`; (b) the cast in updateScene must wrap as prettier prints it: the call argument `appState as Partial<AppState> | null | undefined` goes on its own line, indented, with the closing `)` on the next line. Prettier printWidth 80, trailingComma all. Earlier attempts also failed by (1) an edit search text that appears 0 times in the file - copy every search string exactly from the current file; (2) adding lines outside the planned sites (after lines 209 and 10966) - put every new import inside S1 (lines 90-106) and nothing before S10 (line 10968); (3) unused imports DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME and getElementPageId - import only names the code uses.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
